report.clinical_summary: Patient presents with fatigue and a firm, pea-sized neck lump noticed by wife 3 weeks ago. Has done online research, aware of possible causes including genetics (father had CLL). Reports increased stress, difficulty focusing at work, and has made lifestyle adaptations (more rest, cutting back on activities). Trusts medical expertise and believes treatment benefits outweigh risks. Agrees to examination and further testing.
